findings.rationale: The tf_chain_ingress_role fixture defines aws_iam_role.escalation with an overly permissive assume role policy that enables untrusted principals to gain administrative access.
The tf_chain_ingress_role connectivity.json maps the edge security group jump directly to role escalation via sts:AssumeRole, chaining internet exposure into identity compromise.
The tf_chain_ingress_role security group allows unrestricted inbound SSH (tcp port 22) from the entire internet (0.0.0.0/0), exposing administrative shell access.
The tf_iam_open unbounded IAM policy chains with the tf_s3_public_access fixture where buckets are set to public-read ACL, turning identity privilege into data exposure.
